name: Almond Frosting
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: fine white sugar
ingredients.originalText: three cups of fine white sugar

instructions.text: Blanch sweet almonds and pound them in a mortar with a little sugar until a fine paste
Add the whites of eggs, sugar and vanilla extract to the almond paste
Pound a few minutes to thoroughly mix
Cover the cake with a very thick coating of this frosting
Set in a cool oven to dry
Afterwards cover with a plain icing

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat whites of three eggs
2. Blanch sweet almonds and pound them in a mortar with a little sugar until a fine paste
3. Add the whites of eggs, sugar and vanilla extract to the almond paste
4. Pound a few minutes to thoroughly mix
5. Cover the cake with a very thick coating of this frosting
6. Set in a cool oven to dry
7. Afterwards cover with a plain icing
